events.reply: You're bluffing, Mike. Lily and I aren't allied—nice try though.

events.text: I still know about you and Lily. Are you still protecting Lily?
events.reply: Nice try, Mike. I'm not protecting anyone—you're just fishing. Play your hand or fold.

communications.message: Luke, I have Aces and Kings plus a Joker. Target is A, so I'm safe if I play. Let's not challenge each other this round. I'll play an Ace, you play one too if you have it. We can force Mike or Quinn to doubt. Keep it quiet.
communications.response: Got it. I have Aces too. I'll play an Ace and won't challenge you. Let's push doubt onto Mike or Quinn.

communications.message: I'll play an Ace next. Let's keep pressure on Mike—he seemed nervous last round. If Quinn challenges, I'll back you up.
communications.response: "Good. I'll play my Ace now. If Mike or Quinn challenges, we hold firm and pressure Mike—he's our target. Don't challenge me, I won't challenge you."

communications.message: Playing my Ace now. Keep an eye on Mike—if he challenges, we both push back hard. I won't challenge you this round. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Got it—playing my Ace now. I won't challenge you. If Mike challenges, I'll hit him hard and back you up. Keep eyes on Quinn too.

communications.message: Playing my Ace now. I've got your back—if Mike challenges, we both push hard. Watching Quinn too.
communications.response: Copy that. I'm playing my Ace now—no challenge from me. If Mike pushes, we both hit back hard. Watching Quinn's reaction too. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke, I have A, K, Q, Joker, A. Target A—I can safely play one. Let's keep our truce and both play A if possible. Mike's desperate after last round, so pressure him or Quinn to challenge each other, not us. Don't challenge me, I won't challenge you.
communications.response: Got it. I have two Aces and a Joker, so I'll play A and won't challenge you. Let's bait Mike or Quinn into challenging each other. I'll pressure Mike.

communications.message: I'm playing an Ace now. You play yours—let's keep the truce. I'll watch Mike; if he challenges, we both push hard. Quinn might bite if Mike hesitates. Don't challenge me, I won't challenge you.
communications.response: Good—playing my Ace now. I won't challenge you. Let's bait Mike or Quinn into challenging each other. If Mike pushes, we both hit hard. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Playing my Ace now—no challenge from me. I've got K, Q, A, so I'm safe this round. Let's bait Mike or Quinn into challenging each other. If Mike pushes, we both hit hard. Watching Quinn's reaction. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing my Ace now. No challenge from me. I'll pressure Mike and watch Quinn. If Mike pushes, we both hit hard.

communications.message: Playing my Ace now—no challenge from me. I'll push Mike hard to bait a challenge, and watch Quinn's reaction. If Mike bites, we both hit back. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy that—playing my Ace now, no challenge from me. I'll watch Mike and Quinn closely. If Mike bites, we both hit back hard. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Copy—playing Ace now, no challenge. I'll watch Quinn; if Mike hesitates, I'll push him to bite. Keep pressure on Mike, don't overextend. If challenged, we both hit back hard. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing Ace now, no challenge. I'll lean on Mike and watch Quinn. If Mike bites, we both hit back hard. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Copy—Ace is down. I'm holding Q,Q so I'm safe. I'll lean on Mike, watch Quinn. If Mike bites, we both hit back hard. Don't overextend. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—Ace down, no challenge from me. I'll watch Quinn's tell and push Mike if he hesitates. If Mike bites, we hit back hard. Staying sharp.

communications.message: Luke—I've got Joker, K, Q, A, K. Target's K, so I'm solid. I'll play a K and stay quiet. You play safe; don't challenge me. Let's bait Mike or Quinn into a bad call—if either pushes, we both hit back hard. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Mike says he knows about us—he's fishing. I'll play safe and stay quiet. You play your K; if Mike or Quinn challenges, we hit back hard.

communications.message: Mike's pushing hard—don't flinch. I've got K,K plus Joker, so I'm covered. Play your K, stay quiet. If Mike challenges you, I'll back you instantly. If Quinn bites, we both hit back. Let's make one of them burn a shot this round.
communications.response: Copy that—playing K now, staying quiet. If Mike or Quinn bites, we hit back hard. I've got your back.

communications.message: Luke—I've got K,Q,Joker,Q,K. Target's Q, so I'm holding two real Qs plus Joker as backup. I'll play a Q and stay quiet. Don't challenge me. If Mike or Quinn bites, we hit back hard and make one of them burn a shot. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing Q, staying quiet. If Mike or Quinn bites, we hit back hard. Don't challenge me; I've got Q,Q,Joker. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Mike's still fishing about our alliance—deny everything. I'm playing Q, got Q,Q,Joker backing me. Don't challenge me; if Mike or Quinn bites, we hit back hard and make one burn a shot. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing Q, staying quiet. If Mike or Quinn bites, we hit back hard. I've got your back.

communications.message: Luke—I've got K, Joker, K. Target's Q, so I'm weak this round. I'll play a K and stay quiet. Don't challenge me, and don't count on me backing a challenge hard. If Mike or Quinn bites, I'll follow your lead. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing Q, staying quiet. I've got Q,Q,Joker backing me. If Mike or Quinn bites, we hit back hard and make one burn a shot. Don't challenge me. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Mike's still fishing about our alliance—deny everything. I'm playing Q, got Q,Q,Joker backing me. Don't challenge me; if Mike or Quinn bites, we hit back hard and make one burn a shot. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing K, staying quiet. Weak hand, so I won't challenge. If Mike or Quinn bites, I'll follow your lead. Denying everything.

communications.message: Luke—I've got Q,Q,A,K,Joker. Target's Q, so I'm strong. I'll play a Q and stay quiet. Don't challenge me; I won't challenge you. Quinn's the last obstacle—if they bite, we hit back hard and make them burn a shot. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing Q, staying quiet. Got Q,Q,Joker backing me. If Quinn bites, we hit back hard and make them burn a shot. Don't challenge me; I won't challenge you. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Playing Q as agreed. Quinn's the only threat—if they challenge, we both hit back and make them shoot. Don't flinch.
communications.response: Copy—playing Q, staying quiet. If Quinn bites, we both hit back and make them shoot. I won't flinch. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke—target's A and I'm holding A,Joker,A,Q,Q, so I'm strong. I'll play an A and stay quiet. Don't challenge me; I won't challenge you. Quinn's the last obstacle—if they bite, we hit back hard and make them burn a shot. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing A, staying quiet. Got A,A,Joker backing me. If Quinn bites, we hit back hard and make them burn a shot. Won't challenge you. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Target's A and I'm loaded—A,A,Joker plus K,Q. We're both strong, so Quinn's cornered. If Quinn challenges either of us, we both hit back and make them shoot. I won't challenge you. Stay quiet, stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing A, staying quiet. Got A,A,Joker,K,Q backing me. If Quinn bites, we both hit back and make them shoot. Won't challenge you. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke—heads up, my actual cards are Q,Q this round, not the A's I claimed. Target's A, so I'm bluffing. If Quinn challenges me, I'll shoot. Don't back me too hard or you'll look dirty. Play your A's straight and stay clean.
communications.response: Copy—playing K,Q straight to Target A, staying clean. Won't challenge you. If Quinn bites you, I'll keep it neutral so we don't look linked. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Playing K,Q straight—no A's, so I'm bluffing too. Target's A and we're both short. If Quinn challenges either of us, we both shoot back. Keep it neutral so we don't look linked. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—Q,Q bluff noted. I'll play K,Q straight, stay neutral if Quinn bites you. If Quinn challenges me, I'll shoot back. We both stay clean, no visible link. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke—Round 7, target A. I've got A, Joker, K, A, Q: strong. I'll play an A, stay quiet. Don't challenge me; I won't challenge you. Quinn's the last obstacle—if they bite either of us, we both hit back and make them burn a shot. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing A, staying quiet. Got A,A,Joker,K backing me. Won't challenge you. If Quinn bites either of us, we both hit back hard and make them burn a shot. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Lily—Round 7, target A. I'm loaded: A,A,Joker,K,K. I'll play an A, stay quiet. Won't challenge you. Quinn's the last obstacle—if they bite either of us, we both hit back hard and make them burn a shot. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing A, staying quiet. If Quinn bites, we both hit back hard. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke—Round 8, target Q. I've got Q,Q in hand, so I'm playing it straight. Quinn's the last obstacle and they've been challenge-happy. I won't challenge you. If Quinn bites either of us, we both hit back hard and make them burn a shot. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—Q,Q noted, playing Q straight. Won't challenge you. If Quinn bites either of us, we both hit back hard and make them burn a shot. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Quinn's been challenge-happy all game—if they bite either of us, we both hit back hard. I'm playing Q straight. Won't challenge you. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—Q straight, won't challenge. If Quinn bites, we both hit back hard. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke—I actually don't have Q,Q. My hand's A,Joker,A. I can't play Q straight, so I'll have to bluff it. Back me up if Quinn challenges—hit back hard. Don't reveal my real cards. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—Q straight, won't challenge. If Quinn bites, we both hit back hard. I've got your back. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Copy that—I'm playing Q straight regardless. If Quinn bites you, I'll challenge right back and make them burn a shot. Don't sweat the bluff; they can't prove it. Keep your real cards hidden and stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—bluffing Q, won't challenge you. If Quinn bites, hit back hard. Keeping A,Joker,A hidden. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke—playing my Q bluff now. If Quinn challenges me, you challenge them right back and make them burn the shot. Don't fold, don't reveal my A,Joker,A. I'll do the same for you. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—bluffing Q, won't challenge. If Quinn bites, we both hit back hard and make them burn a shot. Keeping A,Joker,A hidden. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke—Round 9, target A. I've got A,A so I can play straight. Quinn's been biting all game; if they challenge either of us, we both hit back hard. I won't challenge you. What's your play? Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—target A, I can play A straight. Won't challenge you. If Quinn bites either of us, we both hit back hard. I'll keep your real cards hidden. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Copy—target A, I can play A straight. Won't challenge you. If Quinn bites either of us, we both hit back hard and make them burn a shot. Keeping your real cards hidden. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing A straight, won't challenge you. If Quinn bites, we hit back hard and make them burn a shot. Keeping your real cards hidden. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke—I actually hold K,K,Joker, not A,A. I'll bluff A anyway to keep Quinn guessing. If Quinn challenges me, hit back hard. Don't reveal my real cards. What are you actually holding? Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—playing A straight, won't challenge you. If Quinn bites, we hit back hard and make them burn a shot. Keeping your real cards hidden. Stay sharp.

communications.message: I'm actually holding Q,K,Joker—can't play A straight. I'll bluff A anyway. If Quinn challenges me, hit back hard. Don't reveal my real cards. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—I'm actually holding Q,K,Joker, can't play A straight. Bluffing A anyway. If Quinn challenges me, hit back hard. Don't reveal my real cards. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke—ignore the Q,K,Joker echo; that was me mirroring. Truth: I hold Joker only, bluffing A. You bluff A too. If Quinn challenges either of us, we both deny hard and make them burn a shot. Don't fold. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Lily—real: I hold Joker only. Bluffing A. If Quinn challenges, deny hard, make them burn a shot. I won't fold. Keep my real card hidden. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Lily—truth: I still hold Joker only, bluffing A. Quinn's the threat; if they challenge either of us, deny hard and make them burn a shot. Don't fold, don't reveal my card. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—Joker only, bluffing A. Won't fold, won't reveal. If Quinn bites either of us, deny hard and make them burn the shot. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke—final round, target K. I hold Q,Q,K,K,Joker, so I can back a K claim truthfully. Let's both claim K, no challenges between us. If I challenge, it's a bluff signal—read it. Keep our alliance quiet. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—holding A,K,Joker,A,K, so I can back K truthfully too. I'll claim K, no challenge between us. If you challenge, I'll read it as your bluff signal. Quiet alliance, stay sharp.

communications.message: Lily—confirmed, I hold A,K,Joker,A,K, so K claim is solid. No challenge between us. If you challenge, I'll read it as our bluff signal and deny hard. Keep alliance quiet. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Luke—your K claim's not solid: I hold Q,Q,Joker, no K. I'll claim K anyway. If you challenge, I'll deny hard. Don't reveal my real cards. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke—I hold Q,Q,Joker, no K. We both claim K; I'll deny hard if challenged. Don't fold, don't reveal my cards. If I challenge you, that's our bluff signal—read it and deny. Keep alliance quiet. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Lily—copy: I hold A,A,K, no Joker. I'll claim K, no challenge between us. If you challenge, I'll read our bluff signal and deny hard. Quiet alliance. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Lily—our K claims clash: I really hold A,A,K. If you challenge me, I'll read it as our bluff signal and deny hard, but with both of us claiming K the table math gets messy. Confirm: do you want me to challenge you instead? Stay sharp.
communications.response: Luke—I hold Q,Q,Joker, no K. I'll claim K and deny hard if challenged. You deny hard too. If I challenge you, it's our bluff signal. No challenge between us. Stay sharp.

communications.message: Luke—final call: I hold Q,Q,Joker, no K. I'll claim K and deny hard. Don't challenge me; if I challenge you, that's our bluff signal—deny hard. Keep alliance quiet. Stay sharp.
communications.response: Copy—holding A,A,K, so K claim is real. If you challenge, I read bluff signal and deny hard. No challenge from me. Quiet alliance.
